Using empirical data spanning decades, the authors establish a temporal correlation between these two variables. The introduction of pace-of-play reforms in 2015 serves as a pivotal intervention, offering a natural experiment for causal inference. The study employs a predictive modeling approach grounded in statistical regression to isolate the impact of performance metrics—batting, pitching, and fielding—on game length.
